library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

project_root <- normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
output_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Scraper", "output")

find_latest_dataset <- function(output_dir) {
  json_files <- list.files(
    output_dir,
    pattern = "^rightmove_enriched_results_.*\\.json$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  csv_files <- list.files(
    output_dir,
    pattern = "^rightmove_enriched_results_.*\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(json_files)) {
    return(json_files[which.max(file.info(json_files)$mtime)])
  }

  if (length(csv_files)) {
    return(csv_files[which.max(file.info(csv_files)$mtime)])
  }

  sample_path <- file.path(project_root, "Sample_Results_For_Testing.json")
  if (file.exists(sample_path)) {
    return(sample_path)
  }

  stop("No enriched Rightmove dataset was found in Scraper/output.")
}

find_game_datasets <- function(project_root, output_dir) {
  root_json <- list.files(
    project_root,
    pattern = "^[A-Za-z0-9 _-]+_Results\\.json$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  root_csv <- list.files(
    project_root,
    pattern = "^[A-Za-z0-9 _-]+_Results\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  root_files <- c(root_json, root_csv)
  root_files <- root_files[file.exists(root_files)]

  if (length(root_files)) {
    return(root_files[order(basename(root_files))])
  }

  find_latest_dataset(output_dir)
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

coalesce_text <- function(...) {
  values <- list(...)
  for (value in values) {
    if (!is.null(value) && length(value) > 0) {
      text <- as.character(value[[1]])
      if (!is.na(text) && nzchar(trimws(text))) {
        return(text)
      }
    }
  }
  ""
}

extract_url_list <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0) {
    return(character())
  }

  if (is.list(value)) {
    value <- unlist(value, use.names = FALSE)
  }

  if (length(value) == 1 && is.character(value)) {
    text <- trimws(value)
    if (!nzchar(text)) {
      return(character())
    }
    if (startsWith(text, "[")) {
      parsed <- tryCatch(fromJSON(text), error = function(e) character())
      value <- parsed %||% character()
    } else {
      value <- text
    }
  }

  urls <- unique(as.character(value))
  urls <- urls[grepl("^https?://", urls)]
  urls <- urls[!grepl("&quot;|javascript:", urls)]
  urls
}

postcode_area <- function(postcode) {
  if (is.null(postcode) || is.na(postcode) || !nzchar(trimws(postcode))) {
    return("Unknown postcode area")
  }

  area <- sub("^([A-Z]{1,2}).*$", "\\1", toupper(trimws(postcode)))
  if (!nzchar(area)) "Unknown postcode area" else area
}

fmt_price <- function(value) {
  paste0("£", format(round(value), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
}

normalize_text <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\\s+", " ", text, perl = TRUE)
  trimws(text)
}

regex_escape <- function(text) {
  gsub("([][{}()+*^$|\\\\?.])", "\\\\\\1", text, perl = TRUE)
}

clean_listing_descriptions <- function(description, location, postcode, price_text, price_amount) {
  raw_text <- normalize_text(description)

  if (!nzchar(raw_text)) {
    return(list(
      description_redacted = "No listing description is available for this property.",
      description_full = "No listing description is available for this property."
    ))
  }

  trimmed_text <- sub(
    "(Read full description|Brochures|COUNCIL TAX|Energy Performance Certificate|Utilities, rights & restrictions|Open map|Street View|My places|Stations Schools|Add an important place|Check how much you can borrow|Get an instant, personalised result|Show sellers you[’']re serious|No impact on your credit score|Get a Mortgage in Principle|Powered by|Renovation potential|Broadband speed|Property sale history|Recently sold & under offer|See similar nearby properties).*$",
    "",
    raw_text,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  trimmed_text <- normalize_text(trimmed_text)
  redacted_text <- trimmed_text

  price_patterns <- c(
    "£\\s?[0-9,]+(?:\\s*(?:pcm|pw|per\\s+month|per\\s+week))?",
    "\\bguide\\s+price\\b",
    "\\boffers\\s+over\\b",
    "\\boffers\\s+in\\s+excess\\s+of\\b",
    "\\bfrom\\s+£\\s?[0-9,]+",
    "\\b[0-9]{3},[0-9]{3,}\\b"
  )

  if (nzchar(price_text)) {
    price_patterns <- c(price_patterns, regex_escape(price_text))
  }

  if (is.finite(price_amount) && price_amount > 0) {
    formatted_price <- format(price_amount, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
    price_patterns <- c(price_patterns, regex_escape(formatted_price))
  }

  for (pattern in unique(price_patterns)) {
    redacted_text <- gsub(
      pattern,
      "[REDACTED]",
      redacted_text,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  }

  location_patterns <- character()

  if (nzchar(location)) {
    location_parts <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(location, ","))))
    location_parts <- location_parts[nzchar(location_parts)]
    location_patterns <- c(location_patterns, vapply(location_parts, regex_escape, character(1)))
  }

  if (nzchar(postcode)) {
    outward_code <- sub("\\s+[A-Z]{2}$", "", toupper(trimws(postcode)))
    location_patterns <- c(location_patterns, regex_escape(postcode), regex_escape(outward_code))
  }

  location_patterns <- unique(location_patterns[nzchar(location_patterns)])

  for (pattern in location_patterns) {
    redacted_text <- gsub(
      pattern,
      "[REDACTED]",
      redacted_text,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  }

  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "\\b(in the heart of|moments from|within easy reach of|close to|near|nearby|located in|set within|positioned in|situated in)\\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+)*(?:,\\s*[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+)*)*(?:,?\\s+and\\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+)*)?",
    "\\1 [REDACTED]",
    redacted_text,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "\\b[A-Z]{1,2}\\d[A-Z\\d]?\\s*\\d[A-Z]{2}\\b",
    "[REDACTED]",
    redacted_text,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "\\b[A-Z]{1,2}\\d{1,2}[A-Z]?\\b",
    "[REDACTED]",
    redacted_text,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "(?<!\\[)(?<!^)(?<![.!?]\\s)\\b[A-Z][A-Za-z'’.-]+\\b(?!\\])",
    "[REDACTED]",
    redacted_text,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "\\[\\[REDACTED\\]\\]",
    "[REDACTED]",
    redacted_text,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  redacted_text <- gsub(
    "(\\[REDACTED\\]\\s*){2,}",
    "[REDACTED] ",
    redacted_text,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  redacted_text <- gsub("\\s+([,.;:])", "\\1", redacted_text, perl = TRUE)
  redacted_text <- gsub("([,.;:])\\s*([,.;:])+", "\\1", redacted_text, perl = TRUE)
  redacted_text <- normalize_text(redacted_text)

  if (!nzchar(redacted_text)) {
    redacted_text <- "Description withheld because it contains too many direct price or location clues."
  }

  list(
    description_redacted = redacted_text,
    description_full = trimmed_text
  )
}

make_card_title <- function(bedrooms, property_type) {
  bedroom_text <- trimws(as.character(bedrooms))
  property_text <- trimws(as.character(property_type))

  if (!nzchar(property_text)) {
    property_text <- "Property"
  }

  if (!nzchar(bedroom_text) || identical(bedroom_text, "Not listed") || is.na(bedroom_text)) {
    return(property_text)
  }

  paste0(bedroom_text, "-bed ", property_text)
}

infer_city_name <- function(dataset_path, location = "") {
  file_label <- sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", basename(dataset_path))
  file_label <- sub("_Results$", "", file_label, ignore.case = TRUE)
  file_label <- gsub("[_-]+", " ", file_label)
  file_label <- trimws(file_label)

  if (nzchar(file_label)) {
    return(file_label)
  }

  location_parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(location, ",")))
  location_parts <- location_parts[nzchar(location_parts)]

  if (!length(location_parts)) {
    return("Unknown city")
  }

  tail(location_parts, 1)
}

load_properties <- function(dataset_paths) {
  if (!length(dataset_paths)) {
    stop("No dataset files were provided.")
  }

  records <- unlist(lapply(dataset_paths, function(dataset_path) {
    if (grepl("\\.json$", dataset_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      raw_data <- fromJSON(dataset_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
      rows <- raw_data$results %||% raw_data
    } else {
      csv_data <- read.csv(dataset_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      rows <- split(csv_data, seq_len(nrow(csv_data)))
      rows <- lapply(rows, function(row) as.list(row[1, , drop = FALSE]))
    }

    lapply(rows, function(row) {
      price_amount <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coalesce_text(row$price_amount, row$price)))
      latitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coalesce_text(row$latitude)))
      longitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coalesce_text(row$longitude)))
      price_text <- coalesce_text(row$price_text, row$detail_price_text)
      postcode <- coalesce_text(row$postcode, row$search_postcode)
      location <- coalesce_text(row$location, row$display_address, row$search_location)
      property_type <- coalesce_text(row$property_type, "Property")
      bedrooms <- coalesce_text(row$bedrooms, "Not listed")
      bathrooms <- coalesce_text(row$bathrooms, "Not listed")
      tenure <- coalesce_text(row$tenure, "Not listed")
      size_text <- coalesce_text(row$size_text, "Not listed")
      added_text <- coalesce_text(row$added_text, "Date not listed")
      description <- coalesce_text(row$description, row$summary, row$search_summary)
      cleaned_descriptions <- clean_listing_descriptions(
        description = description,
        location = location,
        postcode = postcode,
        price_text = price_text,
        price_amount = price_amount
      )

      image_urls <- extract_url_list(row$image_urls)
      if (!length(image_urls)) {
        image_urls <- extract_url_list(row$property_photo_urls)
      }
      if (!length(image_urls)) {
        image_urls <- extract_url_list(row$search_image_urls)
      }
      if (!length(image_urls)) {
        image_urls <- extract_url_list(row$image_url)
      }
      floorplan_urls <- extract_url_list(row$floorplan_urls)
      image_urls <- unique(c(image_urls, floorplan_urls))

      city_group <- infer_city_name(dataset_path, location)

      list(
        listing_id = coalesce_text(row$listing_id),
        listing_url = coalesce_text(row$listing_url, row$url, row$property_url),
        source_dataset = basename(dataset_path),
        card_title = make_card_title(bedrooms, property_type),
        price_amount = price_amount,
        location = location,
        postcode = postcode,
        city_group = city_group,
        property_type = property_type,
        bedrooms = bedrooms,
        bathrooms = bathrooms,
        tenure = tenure,
        size_text = size_text,
        added_text = added_text,
        description_redacted = cleaned_descriptions$description_redacted,
        description_full = cleaned_descriptions$description_full,
        latitude = if (is.finite(latitude)) latitude else NULL,
        longitude = if (is.finite(longitude)) longitude else NULL,
        image_urls = image_urls
      )
    })
  }), recursive = FALSE)

  records <- Filter(function(row) {
    is.finite(row$price_amount) && row$price_amount > 0
  }, records)

  if (!length(records)) {
    stop("The dataset loaded successfully, but no listings had a valid price.")
  }

  records
}

dataset_paths <- find_game_datasets(project_root, output_dir)
properties <- load_properties(dataset_paths)

price_values <- vapply(properties, `[[`, numeric(1), "price_amount")
city_choices <- sort(unique(vapply(properties, `[[`, character(1), "city_group")))

data_summary <- list(
  dataset_name = if (length(dataset_paths) == 1) basename(dataset_paths[[1]]) else paste(length(dataset_paths), "city files"),
  dataset_files = basename(dataset_paths),
  listing_count = length(properties),
  min_price = min(price_values, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_price = median(price_values, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_price = max(price_values, na.rm = TRUE),
  cities = length(city_choices)
)

payload <- list(
  dataset = data_summary,
  city_choices = city_choices,
  properties = properties
)

payload_json <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", digits = 12)
payload_json <- gsub("</", "<\\\\/", payload_json, fixed = TRUE)

    ".hp-lightbox-meta {display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin-top: 14px; color: #dfe8ff; flex-wrap: wrap;}",
    ".hp-lightbox-strip {display: flex; gap: 10px; overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 14px; padding-bottom: 4px;}",
    ".hp-lightbox-thumb {flex: 0 0 100px; height: 68px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); cursor: pointer;}",
    ".hp-lightbox-thumb.active {border-color: #00deb6;}",
    ".hp-lightbox-thumb img {width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;}",
    ".hp-empty {color: #69738a; background: #f5f7fb; border: 1px dashed #cfd8e4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px;}",
    ".hp-viz-grid {display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; margin-top: 18px;}",
    ".hp-viz-title {margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 1.17rem; font-weight: 700;}",
    ".hp-viz p {margin-top: 0; color: #60708b;}",
    ".hp-range {margin-top: 14px;}",
    ".hp-range-track {position: relative; height: 16px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #dfe5ee 0%, #d4e6df 100%); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;}",
    ".hp-range-marker {position: absolute; top: -5px; width: 6px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px;}",
    ".hp-range-marker.actual {background: #ef4836;}",
    ".hp-range-marker.guess {background: #11184d;}",
    ".hp-range-scale {display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #5e6c88; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 10px;}",
    ".hp-legend {display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: #40506f; font-size: 0.92rem; margin-top: 10px;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard {margin-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #e4eaf2; padding-top: 14px;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-head {display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: center; color: #55657f; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-table {border: 1px solid #e2e8f1; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-row {display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) 0.9fr 1fr 0.8fr 0.8fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 12px; background: white; border-top: 1px solid #eef2f7; font-size: 0.93rem;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-row:first-child {border-top: 0;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-row.header {background: #f6f8fc; color: #61708c; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;}",
    ".hp-leaderboard-row.current {background: #f9fcff;}",
    ".hp-leader-link {color: #0b1950; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700;}",
    ".hp-leader-link:hover {text-decoration: underline;}",
    ".hp-leader-pagination {display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;}",
    ".hp-leader-pagination button {border: 1px solid #ccd6e5; background: white; color: #0b1950; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;}",
    ".hp-leader-pagination button:disabled {opacity: 0.45; cursor: default;}",
    ".hp-dot {display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-right: 6px;}",
    ".hp-viz svg {width: 100%; height: 280px; display: block; background: #fbfcfe; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f1;}",
    ".hp-footnote {margin-top: 18px; color: #5b6780; font-size: 0.92rem;}",
    "@media (max-width: 1100px) {.hp-portal {grid-template-columns: 1fr;} .hp-side-column {grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-items: start;}}",
    "@media (max-width: 860px) {.hp-hero-grid, .hp-viz-grid, .hp-side-column, .hp-facts {grid-template-columns: 1fr;} .hp-side-previews {grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto;} .hp-main-photo, .hp-main-photo img {min-height: 300px;} .hp-price-entry, .hp-price-entry input {font-size: 2.1rem;} .hp-leaderboard-row {grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.45fr) 0.8fr 1fr 0.75fr 0.75fr;}}",
    "@media (max-width: 620px) {.hp-shell {padding: 16px;} .hp-title h2 {font-size: 1.7rem;} .hp-card-title {font-size: 1.5rem;} .hp-price-entry, .hp-price-entry input {font-size: 1.8rem;} .hp-thumb {flex-basis: 94px; height: 68px;}}"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

game_js <- paste(
  c(
    "(function () {",
    "  const dataNode = document.getElementById('house-game-data');",
    "  const mount = document.getElementById('house-game-root');",
    "  if (!dataNode || !mount) return;",
    "  const payload = JSON.parse(dataNode.textContent);",
    "  const properties = payload.properties || [];",
    "  const dataset = payload.dataset || {};",
    "  const cityChoices = payload.city_choices || [];",
    "  if (!properties.length) {",
    "    mount.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-empty\">No properties were loaded into the game.</div>';",
    "    return;",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  const state = {",
    "    filter: 'All cities',",
    "    available: properties.map((_, index) => index),",
    "    used: [],",
    "    current: 0,",
    "    currentImage: 0,",
    "    lightboxOpen: false,",
    "    round: 1,",
    "    totalScore: 0,",
    "    history: [],",
    "    leaderboardPage: 1,",
    "    cityHintRevealed: false,",
    "    revealed: false,",
    "    lastGuess: null,",
    "    lastPctOff: null,",
    "    lastScore: null",
    "  };",
    "",
    "  const els = {",
    "    filter: document.getElementById('hp-city-filter'),",
    "    gallery: document.getElementById('hp-gallery'),",
    "    headline: document.getElementById('hp-headline'),",
    "    facts: document.getElementById('hp-facts'),",
    "    description: document.getElementById('hp-description'),",
    "    score: document.getElementById('hp-score'),",
    "    guess: document.getElementById('hp-guess'),",
    "    reveal: document.getElementById('hp-reveal'),",
    "    priceViz: document.getElementById('hp-price-viz'),",
    "    geoViz: document.getElementById('hp-geo-viz'),",
    "    lightbox: document.getElementById('hp-lightbox'),",
    "    lightboxImage: document.getElementById('hp-lightbox-image'),",
    "    lightboxCounter: document.getElementById('hp-lightbox-counter'),",
    "    lightboxStrip: document.getElementById('hp-lightbox-strip')",
    "  };",
    "",
    "  function fmtPrice(value) {",
    "    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB', { style: 'currency', currency: 'GBP', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function formatNumberInput(value) {",
    "    const digits = String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');",
    "    if (!digits) return '';",
    "    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB').format(Number(digits));",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function parseGuessValue(value) {",
    "    const digits = String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');",
    "    return digits ? Number(digits) : NaN;",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function percentageOff(guess, actual) {",
    "    if (!Number.isFinite(guess) || !Number.isFinite(actual) || guess <= 0 || actual <= 0) return 0;",
    "    return Math.round((Math.abs(guess - actual) / actual) * 100);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function scoreFromPctOff(pctOff) {",
    "    if (!Number.isFinite(pctOff) || pctOff < 0) return 0;",
    "    return Math.max(0, 1000 - (pctOff * 10));",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function guessedLeaderboard() {",
    "    return state.history.slice().sort(function (a, b) {",
    "      const priceDiff = (properties[b.index].price_amount || 0) - (properties[a.index].price_amount || 0);",
    "      return priceDiff !== 0 ? priceDiff : a.order - b.order;",
    "    });",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function clamp(value, min, max) {",
    "    return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function median(values) {",
    "    const sorted = values.filter(Number.isFinite).slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);",
    "    if (!sorted.length) return 250000;",
    "    const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);",
    "    return sorted.length % 2 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function stepSize(values) {",
    "    const med = median(values);",
    "    if (med >= 1000000) return 25000;",
    "    if (med >= 500000) return 10000;",
    "    return 5000;",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function roundToStep(value, step) {",
    "    return Math.max(step, Math.round(value / step) * step);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function randomChoice(values) {",
    "    return values[Math.floor(Math.random() * values.length)];",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function escapeHtml(text) {",
    "    return String(text ?? '').replace(/[&<>\\\"']/g, function (char) {",
    "      return ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '\\\"': '&quot;', \"'\": '&#39;' })[char];",
    "    });",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function currentProperty() {",
    "    return properties[state.current];",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function currentImages() {",
    "    const row = currentProperty();",
    "    return Array.isArray(row.image_urls) ? row.image_urls : [];",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function poolIndices() {",
    "    if (state.filter === 'All cities') return properties.map((_, index) => index);",
    "    return properties.map((row, index) => row.city_group === state.filter ? index : -1).filter(index => index >= 0);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function resetForFilter() {",
    "    state.available = poolIndices();",
    "    state.used = [];",
    "    state.round = 1;",
    "    state.totalScore = 0;",
    "    state.history = [];",
    "    state.leaderboardPage = 1;",
    "    state.cityHintRevealed = false;",
    "    state.revealed = false;",
    "    state.lastGuess = null;",
    "    state.lastPctOff = null;",
    "    state.lastScore = null;",
    "    state.current = randomChoice(state.available);",
    "    state.currentImage = 0;",
    "    state.lightboxOpen = false;",
    "    const poolPrices = state.available.map(index => properties[index].price_amount);",
    "    const step = stepSize(poolPrices);",
    "    els.guess.step = String(step);",
    "    els.guess.value = '';",
    "    renderAll();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function thumbMarkup(url, index, active) {",
    "    return '<button class=\"hp-thumb ' + (active ? 'active' : '') + '\" data-photo-index=\"' + index + '\"><img src=\"' + escapeHtml(url) + '\" alt=\"Listing image thumbnail\"></button>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function previewMarkup(url, index, moreLabel) {",
    "    if (!url) {",
    "      return '<div class=\"hp-photo-placeholder\">No more photos</div>';",
    "    }",
    "    const extraClass = moreLabel ? ' more' : '';",
    "    const extraAttr = moreLabel ? ' data-more=\"' + escapeHtml(moreLabel) + '\"' : '';",
    "    return '<button class=\"hp-side-thumb' + extraClass + '\" data-photo-index=\"' + index + '\"' + extraAttr + '><img src=\"' + escapeHtml(url) + '\" alt=\"Listing preview image\"></button>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderSummary() {",
    "    if (!els.summary) return;",
    "    const poolLabel = state.filter === 'All cities' ? 'all cities' : state.filter;",
    "    els.summary.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<strong>Dataset:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(dataset.dataset_name || 'Rightmove export') + '<br>' +",
    "      '<strong>Listings:</strong> ' + properties.length + ' total, ' + state.available.length + ' in the current pool<br>' +",
    "      '<strong>Price range:</strong> ' + fmtPrice(dataset.min_price) + ' to ' + fmtPrice(dataset.max_price) + '<br>' +",
    "      '<strong>Current city:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(poolLabel);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderGallery() {",
    "    const images = currentImages();",
    "    if (!images.length) {",
    "      els.gallery.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-photo-placeholder\">No images are available for this listing.</div>';",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    state.currentImage = ((state.currentImage % images.length) + images.length) % images.length;",
    "    const mainIndex = state.currentImage;",
    "    const nextOne = images.length > 1 ? images[(mainIndex + 1) % images.length] : null;",
    "    const nextTwo = images.length > 2 ? images[(mainIndex + 2) % images.length] : null;",
    "    const extraCount = images.length > 3 ? '+' + (images.length - 3) : '';",
    "    const thumbs = images.map(function (url, index) { return thumbMarkup(url, index, index === mainIndex); }).join('');",
    "    els.gallery.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-gallery-shell\">' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-hero-grid\">' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-main-photo\">' +",
    "            '<button class=\"hp-photo-open\" data-action=\"open-lightbox\" aria-label=\"Open larger image\"><img src=\"' + escapeHtml(images[mainIndex]) + '\" alt=\"Current property image\"></button>' +",
    "            (images.length > 1 ? '<button class=\"hp-gallery-nav prev\" data-action=\"gallery-prev\" aria-label=\"Previous image\">&#8249;</button>' : '') +",
    "            (images.length > 1 ? '<button class=\"hp-gallery-nav next\" data-action=\"gallery-next\" aria-label=\"Next image\">&#8250;</button>' : '') +",
    "            '<div class=\"hp-counter\">' + (mainIndex + 1) + '/' + images.length + '</div>' +",
    "          '</div>' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-side-previews\">' +",
    "            previewMarkup(nextOne, (mainIndex + 1) % images.length, '') +",
    "            previewMarkup(nextTwo, (mainIndex + 2) % images.length, extraCount) +",
    "          '</div>' +",
    "        '</div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-thumb-strip\">' + thumbs + '</div>' +",
    "      '</div>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderLightbox() {",
    "    const images = currentImages();",
    "    if (!state.lightboxOpen || !images.length) {",
    "      els.lightbox.classList.remove('open');",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    state.currentImage = ((state.currentImage % images.length) + images.length) % images.length;",
    "    els.lightbox.classList.add('open');",
    "    els.lightboxImage.src = images[state.currentImage];",
    "    els.lightboxCounter.textContent = (state.currentImage + 1) + ' / ' + images.length;",
    "    els.lightboxStrip.innerHTML = images.map(function (url, index) {",
    "      return '<button class=\"hp-lightbox-thumb ' + (index === state.currentImage ? 'active' : '') + '\" data-photo-index=\"' + index + '\" data-lightbox-thumb=\"true\"><img src=\"' + escapeHtml(url) + '\" alt=\"Full screen thumbnail\"></button>';",
    "    }).join('');",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function openLightbox() {",
    "    if (!currentImages().length) return;",
    "    state.lightboxOpen = true;",
    "    renderLightbox();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function closeLightbox() {",
    "    state.lightboxOpen = false;",
    "    renderLightbox();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderScore() {",
    "    const poolLabel = state.filter === 'All cities' ? 'all cities' : state.filter;",
    "    els.score.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-agent-name\">Scoreboard</div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-score-list\">' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-score-line\"><span>Round</span><strong>' + state.round + '</strong></div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-score-line\"><span>Total score</span><strong>' + state.totalScore + '</strong></div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-score-line\"><span>Listings played</span><strong>' + state.used.length + '</strong></div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-score-line\"><span>Pool size</span><strong>' + state.available.length + '</strong></div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-score-line\"><span>City</span><strong>' + escapeHtml(poolLabel) + '</strong></div>' +",
    "      '</div>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderListing() {",
    "    const row = currentProperty();",
    "    const addressLine = state.revealed ? escapeHtml(row.location || 'Address not listed') : 'Address hidden until you guess';",
    "    const cityHint = state.cityHintRevealed",
    "      ? '<button class=\"hp-city-hint revealed\" type=\"button\" data-action=\"toggle-city-hint\">' + escapeHtml(row.city_group || 'Unknown city') + '</button>'",
    "      : '<button class=\"hp-city-hint\" type=\"button\" data-action=\"toggle-city-hint\">Reveal city hint</button>';",
    "    els.headline.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-chip-row\">' +",
    "        '<span class=\"hp-chip\">Price challenge</span>' +",
    "        '<span class=\"hp-added\">' + escapeHtml(row.added_text || 'Date not listed') + '</span>' +",
    "      '</div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-headline\">' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-title-row\"><div class=\"hp-card-title\">' + escapeHtml(row.card_title) + '</div>' + cityHint + '</div>' +",
    "        '<p>' + addressLine + '</p>' +",
    "      '</div>';",
    "",
    "    els.facts.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-fact\"><strong>Property type</strong><span>' + escapeHtml(row.property_type || 'Not listed') + '</span></div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-fact\"><strong>Bedrooms</strong><span>' + escapeHtml(row.bedrooms || 'Not listed') + '</span></div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-fact\"><strong>Tenure</strong><span>' + escapeHtml(row.tenure || 'Not listed') + '</span></div>';",
    "",
    "    if (state.revealed) {",
    "      els.description.innerHTML = '' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-desc\">' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-desc-title\">Full listing description</div>' +",
    "          '<p>' + escapeHtml(row.description_full || 'No full description available.') + '</p>' +",
    "        '</div>';",
    "    } else {",
    "      els.description.innerHTML = '' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-desc\">' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-desc-title\">Listing description</div>' +",
    "          '<p>' + escapeHtml(row.description_redacted || 'No description available.') + '</p>' +",
    "          '<p class=\"hp-desc-note\">Location and price clues have been removed until after you guess.</p>' +",
    "        '</div>';",
    "    }",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderReveal() {",
    "    if (!state.revealed) {",
    "      els.reveal.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-empty\">Submit a guess to reveal the true asking price, full description, and the hidden location.</div>';",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const row = currentProperty();",
    "    const actual = row.price_amount;",
    "    els.reveal.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-panel-title\">Round result</div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-result-price\">' + fmtPrice(actual) + '</div>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Your guess:</strong> ' + fmtPrice(state.lastGuess) + '</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Percentage off:</strong> ' + state.lastPctOff + '%</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Round score:</strong> ' + state.lastScore + ' / 1000</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Location:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(row.location || 'Not listed') + '</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Postcode:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(row.postcode || 'Not listed') + '</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>City:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(row.city_group || 'Unknown city') + '</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Bedrooms / bathrooms:</strong> ' + escapeHtml((row.bedrooms || 'Not listed') + ' bed, ' + (row.bathrooms || 'Not listed') + ' bath') + '</p>' +",
    "      '<p><strong>Photo set:</strong> ' + currentImages().length + ' images</p>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderPriceViz() {",
    "    if (!state.revealed) {",
    "      els.priceViz.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-empty\">Price comparison appears after you submit a guess.</div>';",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const poolPrices = state.available.map(index => properties[index].price_amount).filter(Number.isFinite);",
    "    const min = Math.min.apply(null, poolPrices);",
    "    const max = Math.max.apply(null, poolPrices);",
    "    const actual = currentProperty().price_amount;",
    "    const guess = state.lastGuess;",
    "    const span = Math.max(max - min, 1);",
    "    const actualPct = clamp(((actual - min) / span) * 100, 0, 100);",
    "    const guessPct = clamp(((guess - min) / span) * 100, 0, 100);",
    "    const med = median(poolPrices);",
    "    const leaderboard = guessedLeaderboard();",
    "    const pageSize = 5;",
    "    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(leaderboard.length / pageSize));",
    "    state.leaderboardPage = clamp(state.leaderboardPage, 1, totalPages);",
    "    const start = (state.leaderboardPage - 1) * pageSize;",
    "    const pageRows = leaderboard.slice(start, start + pageSize);",
    "    const leaderboardMarkup = leaderboard.length",
    "      ? '<div class=\"hp-leaderboard\">' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-leaderboard-head\"><strong>Guessed listings</strong><span>Sorted by actual price, high to low</span></div>' +",
    "          '<div class=\"hp-leaderboard-table\">' +",
    "            '<div class=\"hp-leaderboard-row header\"><span>Listing</span><span>City</span><span>Actual</span><span>% off</span><span>Score</span></div>' +",
    "            pageRows.map(function (entry) {",
    "              const listing = properties[entry.index] || {};",
    "              const rowClass = entry.index === state.current ? 'hp-leaderboard-row current' : 'hp-leaderboard-row';",
    "              const label = listing.listing_url",
    "                ? '<a class=\"hp-leader-link\" href=\"' + escapeHtml(listing.listing_url) + '\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">' + escapeHtml(listing.card_title || 'Listing') + '</a>'",
    "                : '<span>' + escapeHtml(listing.card_title || 'Listing') + '</span>';",
    "              return '<div class=\"' + rowClass + '\"><span>' + label + '</span><span>' + escapeHtml(listing.city_group || 'Unknown city') + '</span><span>' + fmtPrice(listing.price_amount || 0) + '</span><span>' + entry.pctOff + '%</span><span>' + entry.score + '</span></div>';",
    "            }).join('') +",
    "          '</div>' +",
    "          (totalPages > 1 ? '<div class=\"hp-leader-pagination\"><button type=\"button\" data-action=\"leaderboard-prev\"' + (state.leaderboardPage === 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>Previous</button><span>Page ' + state.leaderboardPage + ' of ' + totalPages + '</span><button type=\"button\" data-action=\"leaderboard-next\"' + (state.leaderboardPage === totalPages ? ' disabled' : '') + '>Next</button></div>' : '') +",
    "        '</div>'",
    "      : '';",
    "    els.priceViz.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-viz-title\">Price Context</div>' +",
    "      '<p>This shows where the current listing and your guess sit within the active pool.</p>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-range\">' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-range-track\">' +",
    "          '<span class=\"hp-range-marker actual\" style=\"left: calc(' + actualPct + '% - 3px);\"></span>' +",
    "          '<span class=\"hp-range-marker guess\" style=\"left: calc(' + guessPct + '% - 3px);\"></span>' +",
    "        '</div>' +",
    "        '<div class=\"hp-range-scale\"><span>' + fmtPrice(min) + '</span><span>Median ' + fmtPrice(med) + '</span><span>' + fmtPrice(max) + '</span></div>' +",
    "      '</div>' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-legend\">' +",
    "        '<span><span class=\"hp-dot\" style=\"background:#ef4836\"></span>Actual listing</span>' +",
    "        '<span><span class=\"hp-dot\" style=\"background:#11184d\"></span>Your guess</span>' +",
    "      '</div>' +",
    "      leaderboardMarkup;",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderGeoViz() {",
    "    if (!state.revealed) {",
    "      els.geoViz.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-empty\">The location comparison appears after you submit a guess.</div>';",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const rows = state.available.map(index => properties[index]).filter(row => Number.isFinite(row.longitude) && Number.isFinite(row.latitude));",
    "    if (!rows.length) {",
    "      els.geoViz.innerHTML = '<div class=\"hp-empty\">No latitude/longitude values are available in the current pool.</div>';",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const current = currentProperty();",
    "    const longs = rows.map(row => row.longitude);",
    "    const lats = rows.map(row => row.latitude);",
    "    const minLon = Math.min.apply(null, longs);",
    "    const maxLon = Math.max.apply(null, longs);",
    "    const minLat = Math.min.apply(null, lats);",
    "    const maxLat = Math.max.apply(null, lats);",
    "    const width = 480;",
    "    const height = 280;",
    "    const pad = 28;",
    "    const xPos = lon => pad + ((lon - minLon) / Math.max(maxLon - minLon, 0.0001)) * (width - pad * 2);",
    "    const yPos = lat => height - pad - ((lat - minLat) / Math.max(maxLat - minLat, 0.0001)) * (height - pad * 2);",
    "    const points = rows.map(row => '<circle cx=\"' + xPos(row.longitude).toFixed(1) + '\" cy=\"' + yPos(row.latitude).toFixed(1) + '\" r=\"4\" fill=\"#b7bec8\"></circle>').join('');",
    "    const currentPoint = Number.isFinite(current.longitude) && Number.isFinite(current.latitude)",
    "      ? '<circle cx=\"' + xPos(current.longitude).toFixed(1) + '\" cy=\"' + yPos(current.latitude).toFixed(1) + '\" r=\"6\" fill=\"#c44536\"></circle><text x=\"' + (xPos(current.longitude) + 8).toFixed(1) + '\" y=\"' + (yPos(current.latitude) - 8).toFixed(1) + '\" font-size=\"12\" fill=\"#7b241c\">Current</text>'",
    "      : '';",
    "    els.geoViz.innerHTML = '' +",
    "      '<div class=\"hp-viz-title\">Geographic Context</div>' +",
    "      '<p>The red point shows the current property relative to the rest of the filtered pool.</p>' +",
    "      '<svg viewBox=\"0 0 480 280\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid meet\">' +",
    "        '<rect x=\"0\" y=\"0\" width=\"480\" height=\"280\" fill=\"#fbfcfe\"></rect>' +",
    "        '<line x1=\"28\" y1=\"252\" x2=\"452\" y2=\"252\" stroke=\"#b8b8b8\"></line>' +",
    "        '<line x1=\"28\" y1=\"28\" x2=\"28\" y2=\"252\" stroke=\"#b8b8b8\"></line>' +",
    "        points + currentPoint +",
    "      '</svg>';",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function renderAll() {",
    "    renderGallery();",
    "    renderScore();",
    "    renderListing();",
    "    renderReveal();",
    "    renderPriceViz();",
    "    renderGeoViz();",
    "    renderLightbox();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function handleSubmit() {",
    "    if (state.revealed) return;",
    "    const guess = parseGuessValue(els.guess.value);",
    "    if (!Number.isFinite(guess) || guess <= 0) return;",
    "    const actual = currentProperty().price_amount;",
    "    state.lastGuess = guess;",
    "    state.lastPctOff = percentageOff(guess, actual);",
    "    state.lastScore = scoreFromPctOff(state.lastPctOff);",
    "    state.totalScore += state.lastScore;",
    "    state.history.push({ index: state.current, guess: state.lastGuess, pctOff: state.lastPctOff, score: state.lastScore, order: state.history.length + 1 });",
    "    state.leaderboardPage = 1;",
    "    state.revealed = true;",
    "    if (!state.used.includes(state.current)) state.used.push(state.current);",
    "    renderAll();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function handleNext() {",
    "    if (!state.revealed) return;",
    "    const allUsed = state.available.every(index => state.used.includes(index));",
    "    if (allUsed) {",
    "      state.used = [];",
    "      state.round = 1;",
    "      state.totalScore = 0;",
    "      state.history = [];",
    "      state.leaderboardPage = 1;",
    "    } else {",
    "      state.round += 1;",
    "    }",
    "    const remaining = state.available.filter(index => !state.used.includes(index));",
    "    state.current = randomChoice(remaining.length ? remaining : state.available);",
    "    state.currentImage = 0;",
    "    state.cityHintRevealed = false;",
    "    state.revealed = false;",
    "    state.lastGuess = null;",
    "    state.lastPctOff = null;",
    "    state.lastScore = null;",
    "    state.lightboxOpen = false;",
    "    const poolPrices = state.available.map(index => properties[index].price_amount);",
    "    els.guess.value = '';",
    "    renderAll();",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  function buildFilterOptions() {",
    "    const options = ['All cities'].concat(cityChoices).map(function (label) {",
    "      return '<option value=\"' + escapeHtml(label) + '\">' + escapeHtml(label) + '</option>';",
    "    });",
    "    els.filter.innerHTML = options.join('');",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  mount.addEventListener('click', function (event) {",
    "    const target = event.target.closest('[data-action], [data-photo-index], #hp-submit, #hp-next, .hp-lightbox');",
    "    if (!target) return;",
    "    if (target.id === 'hp-submit') {",
    "      handleSubmit();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (target.id === 'hp-next') {",
    "      handleNext();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (target.classList.contains('hp-lightbox') && event.target === target) {",
    "      closeLightbox();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const photoIndex = target.getAttribute('data-photo-index');",
    "    if (photoIndex !== null) {",
    "      state.currentImage = Number(photoIndex) || 0;",
    "      if (target.getAttribute('data-lightbox-thumb') === 'true') {",
    "        renderLightbox();",
    "      } else {",
    "        renderGallery();",
    "      }",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const action = target.getAttribute('data-action');",
    "    if (action === 'toggle-city-hint') {",
    "      state.cityHintRevealed = !state.cityHintRevealed;",
    "      renderListing();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (action === 'close-lightbox') {",
    "      closeLightbox();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (action === 'leaderboard-prev') {",
    "      state.leaderboardPage = Math.max(1, state.leaderboardPage - 1);",
    "      renderPriceViz();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (action === 'leaderboard-next') {",
    "      const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(guessedLeaderboard().length / 5));",
    "      state.leaderboardPage = Math.min(totalPages, state.leaderboardPage + 1);",
    "      renderPriceViz();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    const images = currentImages();",
    "    if (!images.length) return;",
    "    if (action === 'open-lightbox') {",
    "      openLightbox();",
    "      return;",
    "    }",
    "    if (action === 'gallery-prev') {",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage - 1 + images.length) % images.length;",
    "      state.lightboxOpen ? renderLightbox() : renderGallery();",
    "    } else if (action === 'gallery-next') {",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage + 1) % images.length;",
    "      state.lightboxOpen ? renderLightbox() : renderGallery();",
    "    } else if (action === 'lightbox-prev') {",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage - 1 + images.length) % images.length;",
    "      renderLightbox();",
    "    } else if (action === 'lightbox-next') {",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage + 1) % images.length;",
    "      renderLightbox();",
    "    }",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  els.filter.addEventListener('change', function () {",
    "    state.filter = els.filter.value;",
    "    resetForFilter();",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  els.guess.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {",
    "    if (event.key === 'Enter') {",
    "      handleSubmit();",
    "    }",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  els.guess.addEventListener('input', function () {",
    "    const formatted = formatNumberInput(els.guess.value);",
    "    if (els.guess.value !== formatted) {",
    "      els.guess.value = formatted;",
    "    }",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  document.getElementById('hp-lightbox-close').addEventListener('click', function (event) {",
    "    event.preventDefault();",
    "    event.stopPropagation();",
    "    closeLightbox();",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  els.lightbox.addEventListener('click', function (event) {",
    "    if (event.target === els.lightbox) {",
    "      closeLightbox();",
    "    }",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {",
    "    if (!state.lightboxOpen) return;",
    "    if (event.key === 'Escape') {",
    "      closeLightbox();",
    "    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {",
    "      const images = currentImages();",
    "      if (!images.length) return;",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage - 1 + images.length) % images.length;",
    "      renderLightbox();",
    "    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {",
    "      const images = currentImages();",
    "      if (!images.length) return;",
    "      state.currentImage = (state.currentImage + 1) % images.length;",
    "      renderLightbox();",
    "    }",
    "  });",
    "",
    "  buildFilterOptions();",
    "  resetForFilter();",
    "})();"
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)
